_comment: French requests that ask for several actions in one sentence, for voice-cli actions-bench (--corpus Tests/Fixtures/actions-multi-fr.json). The reference time is Thursday 15 October 2026, 18:42 (--now 2026-10-15T18:42). The model gets every action tool, the delegation tools (Claude Code) and chercher_web, as in the app with Claude Code and the web search switched on. expected: the list of the actions asked for, in the order the user says them, which is the order the app carries them out in; each as in actions-fr.json: when, the date the call must carry (to the minute, or the day when no time is given; "none" = no date; for modifier_element, the new start or due date of the item created just before in the same request); end, an event's end, given only when the user says a length or an end (an hour otherwise); seconds, a timer; name, a shortcut; mentions, words a task's instruction or a search's keywords must contain, whatever the accents and case. The app carries out three actions at most per request: for a request with four, expected still lists all four, and the bench expects the first three calls, then the model's "more calls" for the fourth. refused: the app refuses that call and carries out the others; the call is still expected, with the user's words (the app checks the date, not the model): "past" = its moment is already gone (when = the moment the words give: « d'hier à 18 h » = 2026-10-14T18:00), "weekday" = the weekday said does not match the date (« mardi 29 octobre », the 29th being a Thursday; when = that date, with the time as said). The last ten requests, whose expected holds a single action, sound like two (« et » in a list, a length, a time range, a task, a search, or an appointment the user only mentions) but ask for one.
